## Providing a space for students to discover independence through positive maritime experiences!

For over 40 years, The Center for Wooden Boats has offered outdoor maritime programs for people of all ages in Seattle. Our youth programs build leadership, observation, and decision-making skills through hands-on activities on the water, with a focus on Pacific Northwest history and nature.

- [summer camps 2026](https://www.cwb.org/summer-camps)
- [Fall Sailing 2026](https://www.cwb.org/youth-school-year-sailing)
- [Free Programs](https://www.cwb.org/free-programs)
- [Young Mariners Initiative](https://www.cwb.org/ymi)
- [Field Trips](https://www.cwb.org/fieldtrips)
- [jr instructor Program](https://www.cwb.org/junior-instructor)

### Our guiding principles for CWB Youth programs are:

- **Engagement** through choice, planning, and reflection
- **Interaction** that builds leadership and collaboration
- **A supportive environment** that builds confidence
- **A safe environment** with trained staff

Our instructors are US Sailing trained and certified in First Aid and CPR. All staff pass background checks through the Washington State Patrol and are trained in positive youth development.

Questions about youth programs? Email [youth@cwb.org](mailto:youth@cwb.org) or call (206) 382-2628.
